name: An Unholy Alliance
label: Quest
description: An Unholy Alliance: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.
Please, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What business is it you wish to speak of, friend? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I recognize the insignia on this scroll, friend. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.

The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... Changed.
If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.
